decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service sits close to the core offer and moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment while its prospects are still unfolding and keeping it costs little.

The open GIS development framework fits the firm's open, extensible component strategy and is cheap to maintain as a platform option, though its limited website prominence leaves its value still uncertain.

The identity service for GIS applications was promoted with launch statements and got its own page in 2024, indicating positive early signals that justify keeping the option open and investing further.
The consulting workshop was launched only in 2024, so uncertainty has not yet resolved, and it reuses existing consulting staff at almost no holding cost.
